correct_completion: I want to order a big sandwich.
full_sentence: I am very hungry, so I want to order a big sandwich.
acceptable_variants: I want to order a pizza.
I would like to order some soup.

options.text: the menu is on the table.
options.why_wrong: This describes the menu, but it is not a result of being hungry, so it does not complete the sentence logically.

options.text: I do not want to eat anything.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of the first part. Being hungry does not lead to not wanting to eat, so this contradicts the logic.

options.text: I want to order a big sandwich.
the restaurant is closed on Sunday.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to being hungry. 'So' needs a result that follows from the first clause.

explanation: The word 'so' introduces the result of the first part. Learners whose first language uses a different connecting structure may place the result before the connector, but in English the result always follows 'so'. Choose the option that is a natural action after feeling very hungry.
translation: Tengo mucha hambre, así que quiero pedir un sándwich grande.
